confirmed_findings.claim: CheckPolicy's unresolvable-base fallback trusts the attacker-writable working-tree policy.Mode, so setting mode=free plus a non-resolving base_ref in acdsl/policy.json silently bypasses the entire policy gate (exit 0, no diagnostics) in gated/strict repos.
confirmed_findings.fix: Drop the free-mode shortcut in the baseErr branch and always propagate the error when the base is unresolvable (no base, no bypass, in every mode); optionally make policyBase fall through to the default candidate chain when an explicit BaseRef fails to resolve; add the missing test case of mode free plus unresolvable base_ref on a repo whose base is gated.

confirmed_findings.claim: The sessions store rescans every batch JSON file in every scope on every GET (Store.Reload full ReadDir/ReadFile/Unmarshal pass) with no cache tier, which will show as page-load latency once the batch corpus grows into the hundreds.
confirmed_findings.fix: Not a fix-now item since it is an explicitly adjudicated tradeoff (D17); keep it on the radar and consider a cache/invalidation scheme like the repo status cache if session-report pages start feeling slow.

confirmed_findings.claim: peekIdentity's mismatch branch logs "another profile's peek holds this port" even when the listener is an unrelated process that happens to return decodable JSON on /healthz, which can mislead an operator debugging a port conflict.
confirmed_findings.fix: Adjust the log wording so it does not assert the port holder is another profile's peek when identity could not actually be established.

confirmed_findings.claim: The peek-port kill loop assumes lsof -t returns one PID; multiple newline-separated PIDs make kill "$pid" fail because the quoted argument is not a valid single PID.
confirmed_findings.fix: Use unquoted word-splitting (kill $pid) or loop over the PIDs.
